name: Returning the Lost Satchel
summary: In Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, you find Maur Grimtotem's satchel and carry it to Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: A Grim Discovery
sections.body: Troggs slew Maur Grimtotem in the fiery depths of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. Even in death, his arms held fast to his personal satchel. Freeing it from his grasp gives you the only clue to why a member of the Grimtotem clan entered the volcanic caverns beneath Thrall's capital.

sections.title: Magatha's Interest
sections.body: Rahauro receives the satchel on Elder Rise and seeks to learn why one of Magatha Grimtotem's clan died needlessly. Magatha Grimtotem herself oversaw the effort, and Rahauro gives a reward authorized by the Elder Crone. Only Grimtotem leadership knows what Maur carried or why Magatha sent him into Orgrimmar's trogg-infested fissures.

faq.answer: Maur Grimtotem's corpse lies deep in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, surrounded by hostile troggs.

faq.q: Who do I turn the satchel in to?
faq.answer: Bring the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why was Maur Grimtotem in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Rahauro says he does not know why Magatha's clansman had to die needlessly. Magatha Grimtotem personally ordered the recovery effort, suggesting Maur may have been acting on clan business.

faq.q: What is inside the Grimtotem Satchel?
faq.answer: The satchel's contents are never revealed to the courier. Maur guarded it fiercely until his death, and it passes unopened to Rahauro on Magatha's behalf.
Savage troggs ambushed and killed Maur in the tunnels of Ragefire Chasm.
Rahauro is the contact on Elder Rise. Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem gives the directive and authorizes the reward.

angles.text: The Grimtotem clan has an uneasy relationship with Cairne Bloodhoof's people. Any secret operation by Magatha's followers in Orgrimmar gives cause for suspicion.
Troggs and cultists threaten the tunnels beneath Orgrimmar. Grimtotem agents are also present beneath Thrall's fortress, raising unanswered political questions.
